release_notes: Build 161 fixes Quiz Release Automation freezing by moving WPF card, visual re-export and thumbnail rendering to a dedicated STA worker thread instead of the desktop UI dispatcher.
Build 161 keeps audio timeline augmentation, FFmpeg work and file publishing off the UI thread.
Build 161 requires Native quiz card rendering to run on an STA thread, preventing worker-thread WPF failures.
Build 161 restores the complete quiz card renderer after the previous release-build regression.
Build 159 corrected the desktop build number shown in the application to match the released build metadata.
Build 157 configuration backup recovery and Build 156 database credential recovery remain intact.
